title: Data Protection Policy
content: All customer data must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Access is granted on a need-to-know basis. Regular audits must be conducted quarterly. Breach notification must occur within 72 hours of discovery.

title: Customer Onboarding Procedure
content: Step 1: Verify customer identity. Step 2: Create account in CRM. Step 3: Send welcome email via automated pipeline. Step 4: Schedule kickoff call. Step 5: Assign dedicated support agent.

title: POPIA Compliance Guide
content: The Protection of Personal Information Act requires explicit consent for data processing. Data subjects have the right to access, correct, and delete their data. A designated Information Officer must be appointed.

title: AI Agent Training Manual
content: All AI agents must be tested with a minimum of 100 sample queries before deployment. Performance thresholds: >85% accuracy, <500ms average response time. Regular retraining occurs monthly.
